definitions.explanation: The state of being different or not the same. The noun form of the verb {違|ちが}う (to differ). Used to describe gaps or distinctions between things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't tell the difference between the two products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{違|ちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's important to understand cultural differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{違|ちが}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなかった→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: We couldn't agree due to differences in our ways of thinking.

notes:
USAGE: This is the noun form derived from the verb ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧. It emphasizes the state or degree of being different.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{違|ちが}い (the difference in/of ~)
- {違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is a difference)
- {違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (to understand the difference)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{違|ちが}い (big difference)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧/{違|ちが}い (individual differences)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ - emphasizes the gap or margin between things (often numerical)
- ⟦{相違|そうい}→相違：04043_soui⟧ - formal word for difference/discrepancy
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧ - distinction, differentiation (the act of distinguishing)
